prompt: My collaborator on Windows can't install our pixi project, but it works on my Linux laptop and the pixi.lock is committed. What's likely wrong and how do I fix it so the lockfile covers both of us?
criteria: Explains that the lockfile only covers the platforms listed in the workspace platforms setting
Shows adding win-64 (and other needed platforms) to the platforms list
Says to re-lock (pixi lock or pixi install) and commit the updated pixi.lock
Mentions handling platform-specific dependencies (target tables) if a package isn't available on Windows

prompt: In my pyproject.toml-based pixi project I want numpy and scipy from conda-forge but requests from PyPI. Where does each go, and what happens if I list numpy in both places?
criteria: States that when a package is listed in both, pixi uses the conda package
Gives the matching pixi add / pixi add --pypi commands
